thread:
Leah: Quick live thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands on security/privacy/compliance. If you raised a question, drop details and we'll track owners.

Marcus: Thx Leah. My customer asked: when will SOC2 Type II be available for hosted API? Need an ETA to include in a renewal discussion.

Irene: High-level: Type II evidence window is underway. We're aiming to provide the hosted Type II report to customers by mid-Q4. Type II for Dedicated/Private is governed separately.

Tom: Can we give Sales a short blurb they can include in RFPs?

Leah: Yes 10-line blurb + status note. I'll draft and post to #sales-ops in 48 hours.

Ravi: ISO 27001 status? Any decision on scope (hosted vs private)?

Irene: ISO scoping meeting this month. Tentative target: certification by end of next fiscal year; scope will include hosted and critical control plane components. Private deployments can be in-scope by request (additional evidence may be needed).

Hannah: VPC/Private GA question: you mentioned audit log export in the all-hands. What formats and sinks are supported at GA?

Leah: GA plan: structured JSON audit events, delivery to customer S3/GCS, and a streaming option for enterprise (Kafka / PubSub). Default console search will show 90 days, archived backend retention 12 months for support/evidence.

Marcus: Will customers be able to set retention on our side or must they export to their own buckets?

Irene: Customers control retention on their own sinks. Our hosted console will show 90-day live view; longer retention requires export/archival by the customer or a support request for archived bundles.

Tom: API to programmatically retrieve logs? Useful for compliance automation.

Ravi: Planned REST endpoints for log export; streaming API for Dedicated. API schema to be published as an open internal doc within 10 business days.

Hannah: KMS / BYOK ask: customers want BYOK with rotation policies and HSM-backed keys. What's the concrete timeline?

Irene: Current: envelope encryption with our managed keys is live. BYOK (cloud KMS integration) preview in ~8-10 weeks. HSM-backed customer keys and advanced rotation controls expected in 4-5 months, pending legal sign-off.

Marcus: Will rotating keys cause outages? Our infra team is worried.

Leah: Design goal: zero-downtime rotation using dual-wrap strategy. We'll publish the rotation flow and ops runbook with the BYOK preview.

Security Bot: NOTICE: BYOK intake and risk assessment required for all customer BYOK requests: https://redwood.internal/security/byok-intake

Tom: Who owns customer SOC2 evidence requests? We had a random enterprise ask today and weren't sure who to copy.

Leah: Primary contacts: Leah and Irene. Backup: Ravi. We will provide a standard redacted evidence bundle. For in-depth diligence, Security + Legal coordinate the engagement.

Marcus: Can we formalize the Sales -> Security -> Legal triage steps in a single doc? Sales needs clear SLAs (e.g., 48h ack).

Irene: I'll own that triage flow. Draft in 3 business days with the acknowledgement SLAs and required artifacts checklist.

Ravi: Runtime question: will audit logs include request-level metadata (model variant, region, response latency, token counts)?

Irene: Yes 10-field plan: request_id, model_variant, region, timestamps, tokens_in/out, and basic cost fields when available. We'll version the schema and notify eng-runtime for integration.

Hannah: UI: will admins have a way to search and export logs in the console for compliance teams?

Leah: Admin UI will get advanced search (filters: time range, user_id, model, request_id) and a bulk export feature in GA.

Tom: Pen test reports 10 common question: can customers get full pentest reports?

Irene: We run periodic third-party tests. Redacted executive summaries are shareable; full reports require an NDA and legal approval. We'll add a templated request process.

Security Bot: ACTION: Leah created Security board card "post-allhands: compliance followups (SOC2/ISO/VPC/BYOK)" -> https://redwood.internal/projects/security/456

Marcus: Leadership asks: 1) Leah 11 publish sales blurb in 48h. 2) Irene 11 publish log API schema draft in 10 days.

Leah: Acknowledged, will post blurb in #sales-ops.

Irene: Acknowledged, will push draft to the docs repo and ping eng-runtime.

Ravi: I'll schedule a sync for eng-runtime & security to review the schema.

Hannah: I'll collect any customer-specific evidence requests in this thread so they get slotted.

Leah: Please paste specific asks here. We'll close the thread after artifacts are posted. :thumbsup:

Marcus: Thanks 11 much clearer now.

Security Bot: THREAD UPDATED: follow-ups captured; ticket numbers created where applicable.
